item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 04/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong southwest monsoon will affect the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong today. The rainbands associated with Chaba's remnant will bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China in the next couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening in the middle and latter parts of this week, the weather over southeastern China will improve gradually. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Aere will move in the general direction of Kyushu of Japan in the next couple of days.
